meta.description: QuotesDone Technologies is a technology company in Dubai, licensed by the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism. We design software and run it.

headline: A Dubai company that ships.
about: QuotesDone Technologies is a technology company in Dubai, licensed by the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism.
We design software, build products from it and run them after launch. Each product has its own name, its own site and its own rules for what it says.
Today that is QuotesDone and Sonobolt. MubinFlow is in development.

principles.title: The price comes first.
principles.body: You see what you will pay before you pay it. QuotesDone shows its 3% in full and adds nothing for paying by card. Sonobolt's quote is the most you can pay, and there is no subscription.

principles.title: Keep less.
principles.body: QuotesDone strips your name, number and company from the brief, and sets essential cookies only. Sonobolt deletes your songs once the mix is ready and keeps no backup of them.

principles.title: Say what we do not know.
principles.body: QuotesDone's guide prices are orientation, never a quotation. Sonobolt marks each song's BPM, key and energy as estimates. MubinFlow lists every figure it cannot yet compute, instead of guessing.
